card.name: Linking words before diuretic names
card.fires_on: Small linking words or punctuation (of, on, or, with, as, e.g.,, an opening parenthesis) right before a specific diuretic is named. It appears in drug-interaction text about diuretics such as hydrochlorothiazide, furosemide or triamterene.

modes.label: Examples introducing a diuretic
modes.description: The marker "e.g.," or "such as" comes just before a named diuretic.

modes.label: Dose or combination wording before a diuretic
modes.description: A small word like of, on, or, with, or a parenthesis follows a diuretic term and comes before another diuretic or combination.

card.writes: It seems to steer the next word away from odd tokens and toward ordinary diuretic drug names.
card.plain: It marks the spot in a diuretic interaction sentence where a specific diuretic name is about to appear.
